decisions.reason: The source changes only Big Block prize amounts and trigger parameters; the independent Small Block mechanism remains unchanged.
The Big Block tickets remain eligible since the previous Big Block draw and reset after that draw; changing the draw threshold does not alter those lifecycle rules.
The source changes prize amounts and draw frequency but does not change random selection, ticket weighting, or eligibility since the previous draw.
Secondary royalties still contribute to the Big Block pool and still do not create referral tickets; only the pool target and prize parameters change.
The source does not change the manual prize-collection method.
Big Block tickets and their metadata counter remain part of the mechanism; changing the prize amount and draw trigger does not require removing or changing counter visibility.
The source does not change the no-referral trigger, random recipient selection, or reward allocation.
The Big Block parameter change has no effect on email magic-link authentication or dashboard access.
The source decision has no effect on the Brevo provider or transactional email delivery behavior.
The source changes only Big Block prize parameters and does not alter the fiat on-ramp provider, conversion, or supported buyer path.
